title: King Josiah Makes a Promise
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler of brave starts, and tonight Josiah stands up first to make a promise to God: Beau goes first in his family’s promise and keeps it on a hard day.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because it takes a brave heart to make a promise, and an even braver one to keep it. In Beau’s world today: Beau’s family sits on the living room floor for a family meeting. Mom reads a verse about loving one another. Then everyone makes a promise together: no mean words in our house this week. Beau puts his hand on his heart and says it first. On Thursday his sister knocks over his block tower, and a mean word almost jumps out. Beau takes a brave breath and says, “That made me sad,” instead. On Saturday the family celebrates with pancakes. Just like Josiah and all the people, Beau learned that keeping a promise to God makes your heart strong.
